title: Source Generators: Less Boilerplate in Your Modules | Orchard Core
description:
Without generated code, Orchard Core fills a shape from an object by reading its properties through reflection, and creates a strongly typed shape from a proxy class at runtime. A sealed view model that cannot be proxied and a feature name from another module go unnoticed, unless an analyzer reports them while you build.

The OrchardCore.SourceGenerators project moves that work to build time: its generators write the code for argument classes, anonymous objects and typed shapes, and its analyzers report shape and feature mistakes while you build.

In this video:
• Why source generators: what moves from runtime to build time
• Argument classes with GenerateArguments
• Anonymous objects and the Arguments.From interceptor
• Typed shapes: Initialize, CreateAsync and GenerateShape
• The OCSG001 and OCSG002 analyzers
• The build properties that turn the generators on in the Orchard Core solution
• Choosing an approach
